description: This file is a test script for verifying the 'git submodule summary' command, implementing test cases for different scenarios involving git submodules including additions, modifications, type changes, deletions, and multiple submodules. It uses shell scripting with functions, git commands, and test harness commands.

methods.name: add_file
methods.description: Adds files to a specified submodule repository, commits the changes, and outputs the short SHA of the commit.

methods.name: commit_file
methods.description: Creates a commit in the current repository with a message containing the provided arguments.
